name: Claudia
title: Commander of the Eastern Front
description: Commander of the Solis Saints' eastern operations. Aristocrat by birth, soldier by choice, and the person most likely to have already planned your birthday party.

dialogue: Oh, don't look so miserable about it.
I've been doing this since I was seventeen. You'll get there.
Come back when the bruises fade. I'll buy you something.
Don't tell Guinevere-onii-chan I said that, she'll get smug about sending you.

swordRanks.title: The Forgotten Shrine
swordRanks.description: Commander Claudia needs someone to activate a shrine to the south. She has opinions about doing it herself.

unavailable_dialogue: Not now, I'm in the middle of something.
Come back when I look less like I'm doing three things at once.
...I'm always doing three things at once. Fine. Give me a moment.
intro_dialogue: Oh GOOD, Guinevere-onii-chan actually sent someone.
Okay so — there's a shrine, southern edge of my territory, needs activating as part of the platform stabilisation work.
I would go myself but I am, and I cannot stress this enough, absolutely buried right now.
Platform seven had a resonance spike this morning, I have three junior Saints arguing about whose fault it was, AND I promised Cygwin I'd have the eastern supply reports done by Duskfall.
Which I will. Obviously. I always do.
The shrine is at the southern marker. You'll feel it when you're close — the ground hums.
Oh also! What's your birthday? I'm doing a calendar.
reminder_dialogue: The shrine! Southern marker! Humming ground!
Also you never told me your birthday, which is fine, I'll find out eventually.
Southern marker. Humming ground. You've got this.
success_dialogue: You did it! Platform resonance is already stabilising, look at these readings—
Sorry, sorry, I get excited about data.
You're good at this. I'm telling Guinevere-onii-chan.
She already knows, she always knows, but I'm telling her anyway.

swordRanks.title: Platform Seven
swordRanks.description: Platform Seven has been causing problems. Claudia wants the player to go take a look — and she'll come with them.

unavailable_dialogue: Platform Seven! Eastern coast, you can't miss it.
It's the one making the horrible noise.
intro_dialogue: Okay so, Platform Seven.
I've been watching the resonance data and something is off.
Not dangerous-off. Just — wrong-off. The kind of wrong that gets worse slowly.
I want another set of eyes on it. Smart eyes.
You have smart eyes. I can tell.
Meet me there?
success_dialogue: Yeah. Yeah, I see it too.
The drill angle is wrong. Just by a few degrees, but at this depth that means the extraction is pulling from a different layer than intended.
Which means the energy leakage is going somewhere else.
The animals in the eastern forest have been behaving strangely for two weeks.
I wrote it off as seasonal. I don't think it's seasonal.
I need to think about this.
Come back tomorrow? I work better after I've slept on something.
Also Cygwin is making dinner and she always makes too much and you should absolutely come.
Don't tell her I invited you, let's make it a surprise.
She loves surprises. She pretends she doesn't. She loves them.

swordRanks.title: Something Worth Celebrating
swordRanks.description: Claudia has organised something. She does this. It is not optional.

unavailable_dialogue: The fire pit, eastern camp, after Duskfall.
There will be food. And mead. And I will be very disappointed if you don't come.
intro_dialogue: Okay so I organised a thing.
It's not a big thing. It's a medium thing.
Fire pit, eastern camp, everyone's coming, Cygwin already said yes even though she acted like she needed convincing.
She never needs convincing. She just likes being asked.
You're coming. I've already added you to the headcount.
Come on.
success_dialogue: See! This! This is what I mean!
My family had parties. Big ones. Correct ones. With the right people and the right food and absolutely no one saying anything real to anyone.
This is — we're tired and the eastern platform is misbehaving and someone spilled mead on the survey reports —
That was me, I spilled the mead —
And it's still better than anything I had at home.
Guinevere-onii-chan gave this to me.
Not the party. The — the having people.
You know what I mean.
Anyway. Eat something. I made too much. On purpose.
Oh! I found out your birthday from the Saints registry.
Don't worry about it. I will handle it.

swordRanks.title: The Wrong Degrees
swordRanks.description: Claudia has been thinking about Platform Seven. She's reached a conclusion she doesn't entirely like.

unavailable_dialogue: I'm still working through something. Give me a little more time.
It's the Platform Seven thing. I can't leave it alone.
intro_dialogue: Okay. I've been doing the numbers.
Can I show you something?
success_dialogue: So. Platform Seven.
The drill angle being wrong means the leakage is hitting the eastern aquifer.
Which feeds the river.
Which is where three villages downstream get their water.
I've been watching the health reports from the eastern settlements.
There's a pattern. It started eight weeks ago. Right when Platform Seven came online.
I reported it up the chain.
I was told the data was within acceptable variance.
And I — I filed it. I noted my concern and I filed it and I moved on.
I'm telling you because I need to say it out loud to someone who isn't a Saint.
Guinevere-onii-chan believes in what we're building. I know she does.
And she's right that the long-term outcome is worth the short-term cost.
She's almost certainly right.
I just keep thinking about the villages.
Don't — don't say anything yet. I'm not done thinking.
Come back in a few days. I might have a better shape for it by then.

variants.title: Acceptable Variance
variants.description: You sided with the Saints. Claudia has made her peace with Platform Seven — mostly.

success_dialogue: So. The Altar.
Guinevere-onii-chan's plan worked. Of course it did.
I've been thinking about the villages.
I went there. After the Altar. On my own, didn't tell anyone.
Brought supplies. Helped where I could.
It doesn't fix the data. But it's something.
Cygwin says I'm trying to personally compensate for a systemic problem.
She's right. She's almost always right about things like that.
But also I'm going back next week.
I believe in what we're building.
I just also believe in the villages.
I think Guinevere-onii-chan would say those aren't in conflict.
I'm trying to agree with her.
Getting there.

variants.title: Going Back
variants.description: You sided against the Saints. Claudia is doing her own accounting.

success_dialogue: You chose the other side.
I'm not — I'm not angry at you.
I've been going to the villages.
Every few days. Just to check.
The health data is still bad.
I think you were looking at the same numbers I was.
I think you made a different call than I did.
I'm not sure you were wrong.
I'm still a Saint. That's not changing.
But I went to the villages.
I think that's the most honest thing I can tell you right now.
Don't be a stranger, okay?
I already have you in the birthday calendar. It's too late to remove you.

rank_up_dialogue: Oh we're doing this? We're doing this!
Okay I have to tell you, I already knew we were going to get along.
Cygwin said 'don't make assumptions about people' and I said 'Cyg, I have excellent instincts' and I was RIGHT.
Don't tell her I said that.
Actually do tell her. I want her to know I was right.
Welcome to the inner circle. There are perks. I organise things.

dialogue: These are going on my desk where everyone can see them.
So they know someone brought me chocolates.
My family only ever served white at functions.
Red is better. Red is for people who actually want to drink, not people who want to be seen drinking.
Last time someone brought me Forza Mead I reorganised the entire eastern supply chain at two in the morning.
It was actually a great decision.
Let's find out what I do this time.
Oh, these are the good ones.
Cygwin would give me a look right now.
She gives me a look and then she sits down and joins me.
Don't judge me, it's a completely normal thing to do.
This is going in the box with the others.
I respect the chaos of this choice.
I will find a use for this fish.

rank_up_dialogue: Okay so Cygwin asked me why I talk about you so much.
And I said 'I don't talk about them that much'.
And she showed me a tally she'd been keeping.
It was a lot.
ANYWAY.
The point is you're clearly important and I'm choosing to own that.
Also Cygwin thinks you're interesting, which from her is extremely high praise.
She told Guinevere-onii-chan.
Guinevere-onii-chan already knew. She always already knows.

dialogue: This is going next to the last ones.
Oh this is the fancy one.
I've smelled this on people at Saints functions and spent the whole evening trying to figure out where they got it.
Actually I need to put this on immediately.
Come sit. Tell me something interesting.
I'll tell you something interesting back.
Don't argue with me about whether I look incredible.
This is not what commanders of the Solis Saints wear.
How does it go with everything.
Oh, from the bad habit collection.
That's a point in its favour honestly.
Let a 'good girl' be bad, for a moment.

rank_up_dialogue: Can I tell you something embarrassing?
When I was small, my family's estate had a whole wing just for guests.
It was always empty.
Not because we didn't have guests. Because guests weren't — they weren't the point.
The point was having the wing.
I've been thinking about that a lot lately.
You keep showing up.
You keep being the point.
I think that's the best thing anyone's done for me in a while.
Don't make it weird.
I'm making it weird.
Okay moving on!

dialogue: You know what, I'm not asking.
I'm not asking and you're not explaining and we're both going to be fine.
You just keep knowing exactly what to bring.
I've been wearing the last one.
She said 'it suits you' and then walked away and I've been thinking about it for three days.
My family raised me to receive gifts graciously.
I'm going to think about this later and it's completely your fault.
Do you know how many of these I have now.
Don't tell anyone I said that.

rank_up_dialogue: Cygwin said I look different lately.
I said 'different how'.
She said 'lighter'.
And then she gave me this look — you know the look, the Cygwin look —
And said 'it's them, isn't it'.
And I said nothing because anything I said was going to make her right.
She's right.
You make me lighter.
I didn't know I was carrying that much until I wasn't.
Also Cygwin and Guinevere-onii-chan are disgustingly cute together and I wanted you to know I take full credit.
I was the one who told Guinevere-onii-chan that Cygwin would say yes.
She already knew.
Obviously.
But I was still right.

dialogue: That's impressive and also slightly concerning.
I'm going to wear this somewhere completely inappropriate.
She would try. She would fail.
You know, I've started associating this smell with you.
This is for after work hours.
You know, there's something about smoking with someone that feels very honest.
Like a shortcut to real conversation.

rank_up_dialogue: My family is going to hear about you eventually.
They'll have opinions.
My family always has opinions.
Their opinions stopped mattering to me around the time Guinevere-onii-chan handed me an actual command and said 'I trust you with this'.
You know what my parents said when I joined the Saints?
'Don't embarrass us'.
You know what Guinevere-onii-chan said on my first day?
'You're going to be extraordinary. I can see it already.'
She was right.
I am extraordinary.
And you are the best thing that's wandered into my territory in a long time.
So.
Stay in my territory.

dialogue: I also respect this specific gift.
You've brought me these so many times.
I still get excited every time.
That's the mark of a good gift.
I have a whole box of these.
I read them when it's bad.
So technically you're competing with yourself.
I have three of these now.
I'll put it on and we can pretend we don't have responsibilities.
